findings.description: The phrase 'all fault reports when fewer than 8 have occurred' does not define the counting period. CON-SUP-110 and SYS-SUP-045 state that fault history is lost on power loss, so reports from before that loss must not be included in the retained history.
findings.requested_change: Specify the period over which reports are counted and retained, consistent with the clearing of fault history after power loss.
